advisory.finding: Removing both prunes makes enrichment queue events (ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE) and TICKET_DIGEST sidecars accumulate without bound per ticket: each certification/enrichment cycle now permanently appends 3 queue events + 1 digest event, and these are reducer-ignored AND compaction-preserved, so nothing ever reclaims them.
scenarios: A frequently re-certified / repeatedly-edited ticket accrues an unbounded number of ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE/TICKET_DIGEST files, growing the tracker and slowing every `reduce_ticket`/`freshness`/`latest_ticket_digest` os.listdir scan for that ticket.

scenarios: CI or a developer environment running git < 2.38 fails the test at the pre_maintenance_merge returncode==0 assertion with an opaque message.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Restore a bound (eviction/prune or compaction inclusion) on per-ticket ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE queue events, or otherwise cap their unbounded growth with certification/drain activity.
evidence: Diff removes the `_prune_queue_events(tid, tracker)` call and the whole `_prune_queue_events` function whose docstring was 'Bound queue growth: keep only the latest queue event per ticket'
attest.py:176 `_enqueue_queue.enqueue(...)` — every certification appends an ENQUEUE_ENRICH
enrich_drain.py:149-160 each drain appends CLAIM (queue.claim) then DONE (mark_done)
compact.py:6 'partition out forward-compat unknown-type events (never absorbed/deleted)' — queue events are not in KNOWN_EVENT_TYPES, so compaction does not bound them
advisory.finding: Removing `_prune_queue_events` makes per-ticket queue events (ENQUEUE_ENRICH/CLAIM_ENRICH/DONE_ENRICH) accumulate without bound: every plan-review certification appends an ENQUEUE and every drain cycle appends CLAIM+DONE, and these reducer-ignored events are never compacted away, so a repeatedly-certified/re-enriched ticket's queue-event count grows with activity volume.
scenarios: A ticket re-certified / re-enriched many times over a repo's life accumulates unbounded ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE event files under its directory.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Ensure the maybe_drain gate's scan cost stays bounded (cap per-ticket queue events or short-circuit the latest-event read) so it does not degrade with accumulated history.
evidence: enrich_drain.py:244 `soaked = bool(_queue.pending_enrichment(_queue._now_ns(), tracker))` inside `maybe_drain`, described enrich_drain.py:240 as the 'Cheap gate' run on ordinary invocations with a MEASURED budget (enrich_drain.py:246 `if gate_ms > cfg.overlap_drain_gate_budget_ms`)
queue.py:164-167 pending_enrichment loops all ticket dirs calling reduce_ticket
queue.py:126-128 reduce_ticket calls `_latest` for ENQUEUE, DONE, CLAIM
queue.py:103-112 `_events_of` opens and json.loads every `-<type>.json` file in the ticket dir (no cap)
advisory.finding: With queue-event pruning removed, the `maybe_drain` hot-path gate degrades with scale: it calls `pending_enrichment` on every ordinary write, which loops all tickets and calls `reduce_ticket` per ticket, and `reduce_ticket` invokes `_events_of` (os.listdir + open + json.load of EVERY matching event file) three times per ticket — so the gate's cost now grows with each ticket's now-unbounded accumulated queue-event history.
scenarios: On a busy repo where tickets have been certified/drained many times, every ordinary write pays a gate cost proportional to accumulated per-ticket queue-event files, breaching the measured gate budget.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Restore a bound on per-ticket TICKET_DIGEST sidecar growth (retention/eviction) or a scan-cost cap in latest_ticket_digest so digest reads don't degrade with enrichment history.

advisory.finding: Removing `prune(keep=1)` from `digest_sidecar.emit` makes TICKET_DIGEST sidecar events accumulate without bound per ticket (one appended on every drain/emit), and the reader `latest_ticket_digest` os.listdir + sorts all `-TICKET_DIGEST.json` files per lookup, so digest reads/freshness checks degrade as re-enrichment history grows.
scenarios: A ticket re-enriched repeatedly (content edits/model changes) accumulates one TICKET_DIGEST per enrichment; latest_ticket_digest/freshness listing cost grows per lookup.
